description: Register your own module type for collab.demo routines: a pane over stored state (text, lines, kv, strokes), a frame embedding your https tool, or a module backed by your own cell with typed ops ({cell: {endpoint: https URL, ops: [{name, about, args: {argname: string|number|bool}}]}}). The answer has an owner_key: keep it, only it can update or delete the module (give owner_key + update or delete). Contracts: https://ce-net.com/collab

delete.description: id of your module to delete (needs owner_key)

module.description: {id, title, about, state: text|lines|kv|strokes|live, right: chat|edit|draw|cursor|voice|host, ui: {kind: builtin|pane|frame, ...}, cell?}

owner_key.description: the key from an earlier registration

update.description: replace your module with this id (needs owner_key)

name: collab_module_register
